chunks: But God has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of scorching wind.

key_terms.السَّمُومِ: Scorching wind; a fierce, hot wind often associated with divine punishment.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Adhab al-Samoom' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of divine protection (Hifz) granted to the faithful, particularly emphasizing the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt in shielding believers from the 'Samoom'—interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as a specific, intense heat of Hell or the trials of the grave. It underscores the transition from being worthy of punishment to being spared by God's mercy, a theme central to the eschatological hope in Twelver theology.
